Agar kisi ne home loan liya 30 lakh ka & EMI banti hai 20k per month or us person ki death insurance lene k 5 saal baad hoti hai to uske nominee ko 12×5×=60 EMIs ka paisa nahi milega agar home loan pe insurance liya hai. Matlab use itna paisa milega -
30Lakh -- 12×5×20000
=18Lakh
Jabki Term insurance me pura 30 Lakh milega.

But aap dhyan rakhen ki Term insurance m kafi types of death include nahi hoti, isliye wohi term insurance le jisme zyada se zyada types of death  include ho
Agar aap chahe to agent se baat karke Accidental cover bhi add on karwa le jo ki normally term insurance mein include nahi hota!
